verdict.rationale: Visa's docs touch this story only glancingly. Commerce signals capturing the user's original instruction are said to allow "quick resolution of most disputes". TAP tells merchants to decline when credential hashes mismatch (likely fraud). A 402 payment IOU lets merchants grant access "with the expectation that the funds will be available" at settlement. Merchant refund and dispute policy fields can be attached to credential requests. None of this states who bears fraud or chargeback liability for agent-initiated transactions. Missing for 10: an explicit liability-shift or risk-allocation statement, documented chargeback and dispute rules or reason codes for agent transactions, a dispute API or process, and independent corroboration.
